title: Saronic mono button
description: A 48px (or 32px) small-radius button with a mono capital label and a thin arrow, turn-down arrow or external-link icon: sonar-lime, a translucent veil for over media, or a 10% ink tint for lime surfaces. On hover it grows 2%, the label rolls up and back in from below, and the arrow nudges right.
notes: CSS only; the grow, roll and nudge are off under reduced motion
optional shortLabel shows below md (e.g. Specs for Specifications)
